purpose: Compare difference-of-reconstructions (DoR) against the direct decoder-delta (DD) implementation of the error-preserving SAE edit, against a float64 reference, on the completed validation inputs.
reference_definition: float64 direct decoder-delta (DD64). Justified by the float64 DoR-vs-DD cross-check, reported per condition.

relative_error_definitions.rel_err_l2: ||approx - ref||_2 / ||ref||_2 (primary; undefined only if the reference delta is identically zero, reported as null)
relative_error_definitions.elementwise: |approx_i - ref_i| / |ref_i| computed only where |ref_i| >= 0.001 * max|ref|; coordinates below that threshold are excluded and counted
relative_error_definitions.significant_digits_agreeing_l2: -log10(rel_err_l2); derived from the RELATIVE error, never from absolute error
